focal_point: A hail before-and-after, stated as a small card. Two frames of similar size.
eye_path: Stacked bands or a split into an offer tile, the default path of this vendor series.
grid: Bands or a split panel. Shared house grid, not an original composition.
scale_ratios: Offer tile is large and usually close to the headline, not a clean 1.6×.
type_choices: Condensed grotesque, tile numerals, more than three sizes, repeated from card to card.
photo_art_direction: Before and after of hail damage, low resolution, small trim.
offer_placement: The comparison is the offer's proof, and the offer itself is small.
trust_and_cta: Phone near the offer. A small trust stack. All of it is this sender's, not reusable.
emulate: Keep one first-step tile and one job photo; drop the repeated chrome.
do_not_copy: The contractor mark, phone, headlines, and the vendor's repeated yellow-or-red tile system. Style reference only. This series shares one house style, so repetition is not independent proof.
summary: Style reference. Before/after needs one large after. This one is even.
